name: product
description: Service-planning interview. Defines the problem, capability composition, and boundaries of a new project, producing .devflow/project/product.md. Use only with direct Product invocation or explicit intent to plan a new project's product or service, define its problem, capability composition, and boundary, or create .devflow/project/product.md.
problem: Preserve the behavior of immutable repository sources `skills/product/SKILL.md` and `skills/product/SKILL_ko.md`, identified by their recorded source hashes, without silently changing their obligations.
state_dependent_behaviors: Durable pre-product research records one origin and routes through direct; it never creates or routes directly to implementation work.
A brownfield-no-product partial managed state routes to Resume for canonical recovery; Product never routes it directly to Adopt.
Managed capability refresh and recursive K ownership belong to Arch; Adopt is only initial unmanaged reconstruction.
judgment_points: Research interruption and re-entry preserve the same direct-owned origin and 00-project card.
